title: Passkeys and recovery
item.name: Passkey {n}
item.never-used: Not used for a sign-in yet
item.prf: Signs you in and opens your data
item.no-prf: Signs you in only – does not open your data on this device
last: Your only passkey cannot be removed.
remove.title: Remove this passkey?
remove.body: You can no longer sign in with this passkey. Your other passkeys still sign you in; to open your data you need a passkey that can open it, your recovery code or a remembered browser.
remove.body-current: This passkey signed in this browser. Removing it ends this session and you sign in again with another passkey.
add.title: Add passkey
add.explain: A second passkey keeps your account reachable if you lose a device.
add.other-device: Add passkey on another device (QR code or security key)
add.confirm.explain: The passkey was created. Confirm once with the new passkey so that it can open your data.
add.cancelled: The passkey ceremony was cancelled – try again.
add.exists: This authenticator already holds a passkey of your account. Use another one.
add.other: Another passkey answered. Confirm with the passkey you just created.
add.done: The passkey was added. It signs you in and opens your data.
browser.title: This browser
browser.remembered: This browser is remembered and opens your data even without a suitable passkey (since {time}).
browser.none: This browser opens your data only with a passkey that can open it.
recovery.title: Recovery code
recovery.explain: It gets you back into your account if all your passkeys are gone.
recovery.none: You have no recovery code yet.
recovery.show: Keep it in a safe place. “Done” saves it after a confirmation with your passkey.
recovery.show.old: Until then your current code stays valid.
recovery.replaced: Your new recovery code is saved. The old one no longer works.
recovery.cancelled: The passkey confirmation was cancelled. Nothing changed; try again.
prf-missing.explain: This passkey cannot open your data on this device.
prf-missing.options: You are signed in. To open your data, choose one of these options:
prf-missing.recovery.title: Unlock with your recovery code (if you created one)
prf-missing.recovery.label: Recovery code
prf-missing.recovery.hint: This opens your data this time. The code stays valid.
prf-missing.remember.hint: This browser then opens your data at the next sign-in without a recovery code. Do not use this on shared devices.
prf-missing.other.title: Use a passkey from another device
prf-missing.other: On a device where you are signed in, open Settings → Passkeys and recovery → Add passkey, and add a passkey that can open your data (for example the one built into the device).
prf-required.title: This passkey cannot open your data
prf-required.body: You need a passkey that can open your data.
prf-required.register: No account remains; your invitation is still valid.
prf-required.recover: The passkey was not added; your recovery code still works.
prf-required.works: Use the passkeys built into your device, for example in Safari or Chrome: iCloud Keychain on Apple devices (iOS 18 or macOS 15 and later) or Google Password Manager (Android, Chrome).
prf-required.bitwarden: Passkeys stored in Bitwarden currently cannot open your data.
prf-required.delete: Delete the passkey you just created in your password manager – it cannot be used here.
prf-required.later: Your registration could not be removed yet; your invitation can be used again in 24 hours at the latest.
prf-required.not-removed: The passkey could not be removed from your account; remove it under Settings → Passkeys and recovery.
